matching.assignment: Complete signed-overlap maximum assignment per retained J/parity sector, including all roots; DC-to-static matching independently checked against adjacent-operator and bare identity. Embed baseline CSFs in the extended complete sector, preserve phases and use full many-electron overlap if radial spinors differ.
matching.degenerate: If any threshold or assignment fails, retain full degenerate subspace/projector and mark scalar line unresolved; do not silently choose a root by column or energy proximity.

gates.original_nominal_NIST_gate: Every upper excitation against same lower must have abs(relative_error)<=0.01; discriminator success is not experimental success.

decision_policy.rank_sensitive: If the complete5p rank arm produces substantially larger differential centroid/splitting changes or resolves more current per-line NIST excess than the same-rank virtual arm, prioritize its native mixed-CI orbital optimization next. Do not infer full rank convergence.
decision_policy.virtual_sensitive: If the balanced layer produces larger differential changes than5p rank at fixed old spinors, prioritize that explicitly defined radial family and orbital response. Do not infer high-l or complete-basis convergence.
decision_policy.both_large_or_cancelling: If both matter or have opposing shifts, no additive extrapolation: union-space rank/radial interaction remains unmeasured and requires a fresh preflight/contract.
decision_policy.both_small_or_worse: Do not expand both blindly or force a success; move to same531 operator/boundary discrimination and higher-l/cross-core hypotheses. A small single increment is not a tail bound.
decision_policy.no_numerical_threshold_redefinition: Original numerical/experimental gates unchanged. Compare actual signed gaps, not total-energy monotonicity or a fitted correction; unresolved matching/resource failure blocks mechanism ranking.
